text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well! I'd say today's results were quite
pleasing,
wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's true I didn't quite reach my
goal. I need
to learn from this as I
prepare for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work even harder to show
everyone
the wonders of feng shui! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work even harder to show
everyone
the wonders of feng shui! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but you know, this is the fruit of
your labor
too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the training program you put
together,
I've gotten stronger. I've even
been able to make
use of feng shui in my
races!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'm going to do
everything I
can to bring home even
better results.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right. The more victories I can secure,
the more
attention I'll receive. I'll show
everyone how
incredible feng shui is!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A happy future for everyone is waiting
just
around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So what are we waiting for? Tell me
about our
training program! I'm going to
give it my all! ☆
